routes.title: The Ruler of the Dynasty Shall be Called "Heaven"

rows.en: Altair...
Yes, Your Majesty...
I shall give you your next mission...
As you command.
Earth... the third planet in the solar system. But your mission there is not to exterminate life.
You are to capture the Data Weapons.
Then, that means the other one is there too...!?
rows.notes: The next reply settles the other one as Dendoh; restored presence verb without prematurely naming it.

rows.en: Yes. The other Gear, Dendoh, has been found on that planet.
Therefore, the remaining Data Weapons are there as well.
Dendoh and the Data Weapons are on Earth...
rows.notes: Restored are on Earth; surprise trails off.

rows.en: I have already sent Spiral Castle F-18 to that planet...
uncertain: Exact Spiral Castle F-18 variant not in glossary; suffix preserved from source.

rows.en: You must go there at once and obtain all seven Data Weapons.
If possible, bring Dendoh into my possession as well. Is that clear?
Yes. Then, I shall take my leave...
rows.notes: Departure formula to the hidden sovereign.

rows.en: Hah, hah, hah...!
W-why...!? Why is this happening to me...!?
Who on earth are you people!? Why do you keep following me!?
Aah!!
U-ugh... ugh...!
Gah!
...So this is all you can do, just as I thought.
rows.notes: Oki assesses Masato after striking him; restored you can do. Contextual reading of dismissive assessment.
uncertain: Dismissive assessment translated as Masato having little resistance; exact nuance could be general disappointment.

rows.en: S-stop... Please stop...!
...Why aren't you fighting back?
You're a boy, aren't you, Masato Akitsu...?
H-how do you know my name...!?
rows.notes: Removed stray closing wrapper and indent; restored know.

rows.en: I know all about you. Now, come with us.
W... Why!?
...Zeorymer is going to awaken.
Zeo... rymer...?
Zeorymer!?
The time has come for our Tekkoryu to rise again!
Fifteen years ago... one person's betrayal forced us to go underground...
rows.notes: Recollection retains trailing ellipsis but restores we and forced action.

rows.en: The previous emperor and so many of our people died beneath the earth... But now we have regained our chance, and our power!
rows.notes: Previous emperor and populace deaths preserved; recovered opportunity and power both retained.

rows.en: Now Tekkoryu shall muster all its might and turn the world into the underworld... And I, Yuratei, shall become its ruler... the Lord of Hades!
rows.notes: Underworld and its ruler preserved as Lord of Hades; no gender inference from masculine source title.
uncertain: Lord of Hades renders literal ruler-of-underworld title; no standalone glossary entry for title.

rows.en: But before that, we must punish the traitor.
That man, Masaki Kihara...
rows.notes: Deliberate continuation of row36: identifies traitor.

rows.en: The vile criminal who stole Zeorymer of the Heavens from Tekkoryu fifteen years ago and destroyed the fortress's central core!
rows.notes: Deliberate appositive continuation of rows36-37; no invented separate command.

rows.en: But... we have learned that Kihara has already passed away...
He's... dead...!?
So he died like a dog...
That is a fitting end for that man.
Therefore, our only remaining mission is to reclaim Zeorymer of the Heavens.
Mighty Hakkeshu, the pride of Tekkoryu! Who among you will undertake this mission...!?
Burrstone of the Mountains will take on that task!
rows.notes: Restored task verb to volunteering declaration.

rows.en: No, I ask that Briest of the Fires and...
rows.notes: Joint request starts here and continues through47-49; retains row boundary.

rows.en: ...Gallowin of the Waters...
rows.notes: Joint request continuation; intentional noun fragment.

rows.en: ...be granted that honor.
rows.notes: Completes Shi-Aen request begun46-47. Speaker requests grant, not offering favor.

rows.en: ...be granted that honor.
rows.notes: Echoes same joint request; predicate fragment follows shared setup.

rows.en: Zeorymer of the Heavens is no match for my Dinodilos of the Earth!
Lanstar of the Winds shall bring Tekkoryu its first victory.
...Taiha...
rows.notes: Actual thought kind; private address/name preserved.

rows.en: If you command that Zeorymer, Kihara's creation, be destroyed utterly... Rose C'est La Vie of the Moon will surely...
rows.notes: Conditional volunteering speech deliberately trails off after surely.

rows.en: ...And what of you, Saiga?
Omzack of the Lightning is incomplete... but even as it is now, it shall surpass the other Hakke robots.

rows.notes: Wordless reaction preserved.

rows.en: I cannot let that remark go unchallenged, Saiga!
Omzack is incomplete... Its power is unknown, so comparing it with the others is...
rows.notes: Luhran interrupted/unfinished comparison; preserves trailing predicate.

rows.en: In that case... Taiha.
rows.notes: Selection address rather than complete extra order.

rows.en: Yes!
Zeorymer is currently in the custody of Last Guardian, the defense organization for the Japan region.
I command you to reclaim it... or destroy it.
Understood, Yuratei.
Then I shall personally see you off to battle.
Yes...
Heh... What a cold ruler. She deliberately chose the one she loves for a battle that could kill him...
rows.notes: Yuratei female and Taiha male supported by glossary; sarcasm addresses assembled pilots.

rows.en: You...!
Oh... Don't take offense, Taiha.
I hope you will leave the task for me... Taiha.
rows.notes: Ritsu asks Taiha to leave a chance for him to carry out mission; request direction preserved. Meaning polish: removed rather, which could imply an unspoken contrast.

rows.en: ...I cannot oblige you.
Damn Taiha... He grows arrogant just because he enjoys Yuratei's favor...
We cannot defy Yuratei's command.
But our opponent is...
rows.notes: Deliberate sentence continuation in75.

rows.en: ...that Zeorymer...
rows.notes: Completes74 with ominous recognition of Zeorymer.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... Taiha. Do your best to win glory for the empress.
Yuratei...
...I believe I understand how you feel...
rows.notes: Taiha addresses Yuratei privately;80-82 clarify inferred motive as lover proving worth.

rows.en: You want me to prove myself a man worthy of loving the leader of Tekkoryu... Is that what you mean?
rows.notes: Taiha addresses Yuratei as her lover; restores him as the man proving his worth, not Yuratei proving love. Meaning correction after draft: emphasizes personally proving worth / inability to exempt Taiha, without implying death or a private conversation.

rows.en: I swear I will fulfill my mission.
Just say one thing... Tell me you are ordering me into battle because you love me.
Do not presume so much! Who do you think you are addressing?!
Yuratei...!
The Hakkeshu are my hands and feet. All you need do is obey my commands.
rows.notes: Royal command; Hakkeshu metaphor retained.

rows.en: Yes...
I am the Empress of Tekkoryu... I could not single you out and tell you to come back alive...
rows.notes: Private thought addressed to Taiha; female identity sourced in glossary. Restores inability to single him out. Meaning correction after draft: emphasizes personally proving worth / inability to exempt Taiha, without implying death or a private conversation.

rows.en: I could not single you out and tell you not to go...
rows.notes: Continuation of private regret; restores I could not say rather than subjectless fragment. Meaning correction after draft: emphasizes personally proving worth / inability to exempt Taiha, without implying death or a private conversation.

rows.en: Taiha... Oh, Taiha...
...Dr. Inoue, how has Dendoh been doing since then?
Well, there are no obvious problems for now, and the children seem to be getting used to Dendoh.
I see... We have Colonel Bright and the others to thank for that. And what about the things we discussed?
Eris Willamette has already found several clues.
And... Now that Dendoh has activated, they may reveal themselves to us.
rows.notes: They refers to the sought Data Weapons, settled by opening scene and prior Operation D context.

rows.en: In that case, we will have to hurry the Cell Fighter's rollout...
Kirakuni and Eris are standing by at the development plant right now.
As soon as it is finished, we should be able to send the Cell Fighter straight into combat.
Good... Once we have Dendoh's support system in place, I will report our current situation to Gozen.
rows.notes: Gozen fixed contextual title/alias approved centrally from Shibuya profile; identity not exposed in body. No invented Commander rank.
uncertain: Gozen is a source-backed contextual alias; independently canonical English title remains unestablished.

rows.en: Chief, we have an incoming transmission from Last Guardian.
Oki...? Put it through to me.
Yes, sir.
...It has been a while, Chief Shibuya.
Indeed...
I have read your report. It seems Operation D went well.
But this is only the beginning. With Gulfer having established Spiral Castle on the Moon, our war with them looks set to drag on.
Spiral Castle... So that is its name. Did that information come from her as well?
rows.notes: Her preserves explicit source female pronoun without adding a name.

rows.en: Yes. ...So, what can I do for you?
...We just received a report from the Federation Forces' Changchun Base. They have spotted a mysterious giant mobile weapon.
rows.notes: Changchun Base approved centrally: Chukyo University table maps the Japanese reading to Changchun; Base is source-literal. No Akurasu entry found.

rows.en: A giant mobile weapon, you say?
Yes. It seems they have already lost track of it... But they did manage to capture images of it.
Hmm...! Could this possibly be...?
Yes... We believe it is a Hakke robot.
rows.notes: Ignored stray closing wrapper and empty break per brief.

rows.en: Then they have finally begun to make their move...!
Yes. Hau Dragon, the enemy of our organization, Last Guardian, has...
rows.notes: Hau Dragon exact main-glossary term and Akurasu organization confirmed centrally; unfinished has reflects source ellipsis. Exact organization alias Hau Dragon retained; distinct from any unit of that name.

rows.en: And their immediate target is us.
Oki, GEAR, which I oversee, and your organization were originally one and the same...
Is there anything we can do for you?
Please do not worry about us. We have a plan of our own.
A plan...?! Surely you do not mean that it can be activated?!
That is correct.
But what about its pilot...?
rows.notes: Question restores pilot concern without adding a gender.

rows.en: We have already secured him and confined him in a solitary cell.
Confined him...?! What is the meaning of this?!
He has lived an ordinary life for almost fifteen years... I believe this is an effective way to build up his will to fight in a short time.
rows.notes: He is Masato, male sourced glossary; retains almost fifteen years and coercive short-term motivation.
Chief Shibuya silence preserved.

rows.en: Masato Akitsu... Just like the children chosen by Dendoh, he is someone destined to fight.
rows.notes: Masato Akitsu full name and male pronoun glossary sourced.

rows.en: ...Then I will ask the Nahel Argama unit, a super robot force, to support you in case anything goes wrong.
rows.notes: Super robot force follows campaign term for special-unit classification.

rows.en: ...Understood.
Please, just let me out already!
rows.notes: Ignored stray closing wrapper and empty break.

rows.en: How long are you going to keep me locked up in a place like this?! I... I have not done anything!!
Please! Let me out of here!!
P-please...! L-let me...
rows.notes: Stammered unfinished plea across row boundary retained; ignored stray wrapper.

rows.en: Let me... out of here...!
rows.notes: Masato asks captors to release him; direction explicit.

rows.en: ...Miku, how is he doing?
His condition is becoming dangerous.
I see.
Is he... going to be all right...?
If that is all it takes to break his mind, he would be happier that way.
rows.notes: He refers to glossary-confirmed male Masato; harsh mental-collapse statement retained.

rows.en: What...?!
Oki, there is a high-energy reading above the base!
Hmph, so they have found us. Miku, let him out of his solitary cell.
We are sending it... Zeorymer, into battle.
Yes...!
Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Shoot down Zeorymer of the Heavens
rows.notes: Plain objective, one segment, no @.

rows.en: Hmph, I knew there were plenty of special bases in the Japan region...
But I never imagined Zeorymer was hidden in a place like this. Heh, a forest really is the best place to hide a tree...
rows.notes: Forest/tree proverb is a boast about the hidden base, not a literal change of location.

rows.en: W-what is that...?! A giant... robot?!
So it is Hau Dragon after all...!
rows.notes: Exact organization alias Hau Dragon retained; distinct from any unit of that name.

rows.en: Hau... Dragon?!
rows.notes: Exact organization alias Hau Dragon retained; distinct from any unit of that name.

rows.en: Yes. It is another name for the secret society Tekkoryu.
rows.notes: Hau Dragon is an alias of Tekkoryu, preserving the two source names rather than conflating them. Exact organization alias Hau Dragon retained; distinct from any unit of that name.

rows.en: A secret society... Tekkoryu...?
rows.notes: Deliberate incredulous echo, no invented assertion.

rows.en: W-what? I have heard that name before...
rows.notes: Thought uses actual-kind fitting; recognition restored as I have heard.

rows.en: Oki, did you ask the military for support?
We did not ask for it ourselves... But the Nahel Argama unit should be on its way here.
rows.notes: Support is offered externally; Oki did not request it. Nahel Argama unit expected to arrive.

rows.en: Will that be all right?
rows.notes: Miku worries about outside military involvement; does not invent a secrecy explanation.

rows.en: There is no need to worry. If anything, that unit is much like us in Last Guardian.
However... If possible, I would like to settle this before they arrive.
Yes, I understand.
H-how... did it come to this...?!
rows.notes: Panicked question restores event subject it.

rows.en: We have no time! Masato, trust me!
rows.notes: Miku asks Masato to trust her; request direction preserved.

rows.en: You say that, but...! U-uaaaah!!
rows.notes: Masato answers Miku's demand to trust her; resistance breaks into a scream. Opening trails off deliberately.

rows.en: Zeorymer has responded to you, Masato.
rows.notes: Miku addresses Masato; the robot responds to him, not the reverse.

rows.en: At last, the time of awakening has come...!
rows.notes: Oki sees Zeorymer awaken and welcomes its long-awaited awakening.

rows.en: W-where am I...!?
rows.notes: Masato has just awakened inside the cockpit; restored where am I.

rows.en: Masato.
rows.notes: Voice addresses Masato; source speaker remains hidden as ???.

rows.en: That voice...! Where are you!?
rows.notes: Masato recognizes the voice but cannot locate its speaker; both questions retained.

rows.en: We're inside a giant robot now.
rows.notes: Hidden voice explains their shared cockpit situation; preserved ???.

rows.en: What did you say...!?
rows.notes: Masato incredulously repeats the hidden voice's revelation that they are inside a robot.

rows.en: The two of us are going to pilot Zeorymer together.
rows.notes: Hidden voice assigns both occupants to co-pilot Zeorymer; preserved ???.

rows.en: W-what for!? And how am I supposed to do that!?
rows.notes: Masato asks the purpose and protests his ability; restored complete English question.

rows.en: So you've appeared... Zeorymer of the Heavens...!
rows.notes: Taiha sees Zeorymer; rearranged interrupted Japanese title to natural English order while retaining pause.

rows.en: Watch me, Yuratei. I'll prove to you who the greatest warrior among Tekkoryu's Hakkeshu is...!
rows.notes: Taiha mentally addresses Yuratei and promises proof of superiority among Tekkoryu Hakkeshu. I is explicit; no added romantic identity.

rows.en: Masato, that's one of Hau Dragon's Hakke robots... It's our enemy.
rows.notes: Context: immediate battle reaction to the preceding action; natural spoken register and complete source content retained.

rows.en: Our enemy!? You're telling me to fight that thing!? That's insane!!
rows.notes: Context: immediate battle reaction to the preceding action; natural spoken register and complete source content retained.

rows.en: You can do it. The way you are now.
rows.notes: Miku reassures Masato that his current state enables him to fight; second phrase deliberately qualifies first.

rows.en: !! Why?!
rows.notes: Masato demands why Miku believes his current self can fight.

rows.en: This Lanstar of the Winds was built to perfection over fifteen years...! It's nothing like that traitor's scrap heap!
rows.notes: Taiha boasts of fifteen years of perfect construction and demeans the traitor's robot; both details retained.

rows.en: It's coming, Masato!
rows.notes: Miku warns Masato that Taiha's robot is approaching.

rows.en: U-uaaaaah!!
rows.notes: Masato screams at the incoming attack.

rows.en: That machine...! Could it be the Gulfer Royal Guard commander's...!?
rows.notes: Duke recognizes the enemy machine as the Gulfer Royal Guard commander's; source possessive trails off, no machine name supplied.

rows.en: Oh... So Grendizer has come to Earth too...
rows.notes: Altair recognizes Duke's Grendizer on Earth; surprised, composed enemy tone.

rows.en: Hold it, you fake Dendoh!
rows.notes: Ginga addresses Altair's lookalike robot as fake Dendoh, not as a new canonical unit name.

rows.en: ...Don't be so eager to die, Dendoh!
rows.notes: Altair taunts Dendoh; death threat preserved.

rows.en: Ugh...!
rows.notes: Ginga grunts in response to Altair's threatening attack.

rows.en: Th-this guy... He knows who we are...!?
rows.notes: Hokuto addresses Ginga about Altair, whose identity is not expanded; male pronoun supported by glossary Altair profile.

rows.en: I don't have time to deal with you right now...!
rows.notes: Altair refuses to spend time fighting Dendoh; restored I and you.

rows.en: You are...!
rows.notes: Altair recognizes Vega; interrupted recognition retained without guessing an identity reveal.
Vega is startled when Altair recognizes her.

rows.en: Why...? I've piloted this before... sometime...
rows.notes: Masato recognizes prior piloting experience; I restored; sometime left vague as source.

rows.en: Good! Keep it up!
rows.notes: Miku urges Masato to maintain his newly discovered piloting performance.

rows.en: But that... can't be true...!
rows.notes: Masato doubts his apparent memory; impersonal that keeps the settled antecedent.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... It seems you still can't unleash your full power. Is that because that man died...?
rows.notes: Taiha addresses Zeorymer's pilot; that man remains unnamed rather than prematurely identifying Masaki.

rows.en: Masato, you don't need to be afraid. You can do it.
rows.notes: Miku reassures Masato; she is urging him to fight, not offering to take his role.

rows.en: Even if you say that...!
rows.notes: Masato resists reassurance; source protest deliberately trails off.

rows.en: You'll be all right. You survived the battle just now, didn't you?
rows.notes: Miku cites Masato surviving the preceding combat, not winning it.

rows.en: Th-that was...!
rows.notes: Masato starts a rebuttal then stops; deliberate fragment.

rows.en: Locking him in solitary confinement to build his will to fight paid off. His combat balance is incredible for a middle schooler.
rows.notes: Oki thinks about his prior confinement of Masato increasing fighting spirit; him and his identify Masato. Combat balance remains technical and broad.
uncertain: Combat balance is a source technical description; precise stat/system sense is not established in this scene.

rows.en: Come on, Masato! Fight!
rows.notes: Miku orders Masato to fight; direction preserved.
Silent reaction only; no invented words.

rows.en: Kindness only gets in the way in battle.
rows.notes: Oki rejects kindness as an obstacle to combat; declarative verb restored.

rows.en: Damn, you stubborn bastard...!
rows.notes: Taiha vents frustration at Zeorymer's resistance; insult retains hostile force.

rows.en: U-uuugh...!
rows.notes: Masato groans under combat strain.

rows.en: Any more fighting will put too much strain on Masato.
rows.notes: Miku considers continuing combat harmful to Masato, not his opponents.

rows.en: And if we keep taking hits, even Zeorymer...
rows.notes: Miku thinks of their robot repeatedly receiving attacks; we restored and outcome deliberately trails off. Final corrects the draft's invented won't; source leaves the danger as an unfinished clause.

rows.en: So the Nahel Argama squad has arrived...
rows.notes: Oki notices allied Nahel Argama squad arrival; not a question to the squad.

rows.en: I won't let the likes of you interfere! I'll finish this in one blow!
rows.notes: Taiha rejects new arrivals' interference and intends to end the fight immediately.

rows.en: U-uuurgh!!
rows.notes: Masato cries out during Taiha's attack.

rows.en: I'll disable it just like this, then carry it away...!
rows.notes: Taiha intends disabling and taking Zeorymer; it refers to the robot, not Masato.

rows.en: Masato! Masato!!
rows.notes: Miku urgently calls Masato twice as he stops responding.
Masato remains wordlessly stunned immediately before the awakening of his aggressive side.

rows.en: ...I can win...!
rows.notes: Masato's demeanor changes; first-person victory claim restored.

rows.en: W-what!?
rows.notes: Taiha is shocked by Masato's confidence and ensuing power surge.

rows.en: !! Wh-what is this energy reading!?
rows.notes: Prefilled runtime speaker nickname retained exactly; reading concerns Zeorymer's escalating energy.

rows.en: It just keeps rising...! Can that machine really withstand it!?
rows.notes: Rain reports energy continuing to rise and doubts the robot can survive it.

rows.en: ...Heh... Heh heh heh heh...
rows.notes: Masato's unsettling laugh retained.

rows.en: Wh-what... is this feeling!?
rows.notes: Judau senses disturbing pressure from the robot and asks what it is.

rows.en: I-I feel kind of sick...!
rows.notes: Ple reacts with discomfort to the oppressive sensation.

rows.en: I feel... an incredibly strong pressure...!
rows.notes: Ple Two senses oppressive pressure; I restored.

rows.en: Hey, what's wrong with you!?
rows.notes: Kaine asks the visibly distressed psychic pilots what is wrong.

rows.en: It's his aura...! That robot is giving off an extraordinary aura!
rows.notes: Domon identifies the robot's extraordinary martial aura; no named technique added.
uncertain: Aura renders ki contextually; no fixed glossary entry for this martial-energy common noun.

rows.en: What!?
rows.notes: Kaine reacts incredulously to Domon's report of abnormal aura.

rows.en: What power...! So this is the power of the Heavens!
rows.notes: Taiha recognizes the enormous power as Zeorymer's Heavens element.

rows.en: But I can't lose...! I can't retreat! For the sake of my love, I cannot lose this battle!
rows.notes: Taiha invokes his love without naming its recipient; cannot lose or retreat retained.

rows.en: I can't lose! Not this battleee!!
rows.notes: Taiha repeats that he cannot lose this particular battle; prolonged cry retained. Final places the stretched cry on battle, matching source emphasis rather than adding no.

rows.en: The 'Wind,' huh... The weaker they are, the more they love buzzing around...!
rows.notes: Changed Masato mocks the Wind element and weaker opponents' noisy flying; quotation reflects elemental name.

rows.en: I-in just one blow...!!
rows.notes: Observer reacts to the one-blow result; deliberate source shock fragment.

rows.en: Wh-what destructive power...!
rows.notes: Light is shocked by the destructive power of the single strike.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... I won... I won...!
rows.notes: Masato gloats after defeating Taiha; repeated I won and sinister laugh retained.
Silent startled reaction marks Masato's return; no invented words.

rows.en: ! Why!?
rows.notes: Masato asks why in shock; question remains short because next row states the specific question.

rows.en: Why am I... inside this thing...!?
rows.notes: Masato questions being inside the robot; I restored.

rows.en: Masato, are you hurt!?
rows.notes: Miku asks about Masato's injuries; full question restored.

rows.en: Tell me... What is Zeorymer...!
rows.notes: Masato demands information, then begins the Zeorymer question continued in233; deliberate trailing fragment.

rows.en: What... IS Zeorymer!?
rows.notes: Repeated Zeorymer question shouted. Final uses capitalized IS for the cry while preserving canonical unit spelling.

rows.en: ...Masato...
rows.notes: Miku softly addresses Masato; no invented answer.

rows.en: Ugh, uuugh...!!
rows.notes: Masato groans in distress after demanding Zeorymer's identity.

rows.en: ...Oki, Zeorymer needs to be readjusted. Please give us permission to withdraw.
rows.notes: Miku requests Oki's permission for their withdrawal; request direction explicit, readjustment preserved.

rows.en: Yes, understood.
rows.notes: Oki accepts Miku's withdrawal request; acknowledges it as permission.

rows.en: H-hey... That robot went back!
rows.notes: Ginga tells companions the robot returned/left for its base; no destination invented.

rows.en: So that's... Last Guardian's secret weapon...
rows.notes: Vega identifies the robot as Last Guardian's secret weapon; full predicate restored.

rows.en: I heard the rumors, but I never imagined it had that much destructive power...
W-what!?
Captain! There's a malfunction in the main computer!
What? What's causing it?!
I-I don't know! The monitor's image is breaking up...!
O-our computer's gone haywire too!
Could this have something to do with that robot from before?
rows.notes: Restored a full question about the previous robot, identified as Zeorymer in the preceding event.

rows.en: No, I don't think so. It looks like something's jamming us.
The computers are malfunctioning? Could it be...?
Dendoh seems to be fine, though...
#女愛称, can't you figure out what's causing this?
I want to check, but the monitor won't display any data.
Hey, Light. This is where your D-3 comes in, isn't it?
Don't get so worked up. I'll have the answer any minute... Huh?! What's this image?!
It's showing up here too! Is that... a horse?!
Did you say a horse...?
Fuunsaiki...?! No, it's the wrong color!
What is it this time?!
Urgent message from GEAR HQ! A group of objects believed to be Gulfer are rapidly descending toward us!
What did you say?! The Gulfer?!
All units, prepare to intercept!!
Machine Beasts for capturing...! Then there's no doubt!
rows.notes: Machine Beasts are capture-purpose units; Vega infers a Data Weapon is nearby.

rows.en: No doubt about what?!
It's going to appear!
rows.notes: Vega deliberately leaves the imminent entity unnamed; next lines identify Unicorn Drill.

rows.en: What is?!
Th-that's it...! It's the thing we saw on the monitor!
I knew it, Unicorn Drill...! Could Zeorymer's energy have drawn it here?!
Is that a Gulfer too?!
No, Hokuto...! I mean, young Hokuto. It's a Data Weapon... an electronic sacred beast that can also become Dendoh's weapon.
rows.notes: Preserved the source self-correction from intimate Hokuto to Hokuto-kun using young Hokuto; literal electronic sacred beast explanation retained.
uncertain: Honorific self-correction has no exact English equivalent under honorific-drop convention; young Hokuto provisionally preserves the distancing slip.

rows.en: What?! That horse becomes a weapon?!
rows.notes: Restored becomes to make the surprised question a complete proposition.

rows.en: Do you mean Dendoh rides on it, like God Gundam?!
rows.notes: God Gundam/Fuunsaiki riding analogy refers to Dendoh riding Unicorn Drill.

rows.en: No, that's not it... Anyway, don't let the Gulfer have it!
If you can, I want you two to catch it! If the Gulfer get it, we'll be in terrible trouble!
rows.notes: Vega asks Hokuto and Ginga to capture the beast; request direction preserved.

rows.en: O-okay! Let's go, Hokuto!
Y-yeah!
Then we'll cover you! You two concentrate on catching that horse!
Yeah, you got it!!
1. Unicorn Drill destroyed  4. Allied mothership lost@2. GEAR Fighter Dendoh destroyed@3. Valkyrie destroyed
rows.notes: Defeat-condition list; all four conditions and source two @ separators retained. Measured initial first segment 380px; shortened its second destroyed to lost and reduced separator spaces, retaining all four defeat conditions.

rows.en: An object is approaching from above!
Is it Gulfer?!
It seems so, but that shape...!!
Knight GEAR Ogre!! It can't be...!!
Huh...?! Whaaat?!
A black... Dendoh?!
rows.notes: Surprised noun identification deliberately remains a fragment.

rows.en: Hmph... So this is the other Gear, Dendoh.
Is that thing... on our side?!
No, it's an enemy! Just get away for now!!
Get away...? But then the Data Weapon will...!
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished concern about the Data Weapon retained.

rows.en: Just listen to me and wait for another chance!!
But if they catch that horse, we'll be in trouble, right?!
W-well, yes...!
rows.notes: Deliberate hesitant reply remains unfinished.

rows.en: Then we'll handle the others! Hokuto, Ginga! You two catch that horse!
rows.notes: Restored context-settled catch command for the two Dendoh pilots.

rows.en: Domon?!
Vega, if we run away now, things will only get worse, won't they?!
Y-yes, they will... Ryoma.
Then we'll help you too!
...We're already in this together. I'll see it through to the end with you.
rows.notes: Boat idiom rendered as shared commitment, not a literal ship reference.

rows.en: Yeah, it's still too soon for us to run away.
We can't let kids younger than us see us looking bad, right?
You've got that right.
And in my line of work, I'm interested in those Data Weapons too.
rows.notes: Light refers to his technical/sensor role with D-3.

rows.en: Th-those boys... They've learned to talk big.
rows.notes: Ben reacts to the three Dragonar pilots taking initiative; appreciative gruff surprise retained.

rows.en: Thank you, all of you...!
The Data Weapon, Unicorn Drill... No, there's another one here.
Just as well. I'll save that one first.
rows.notes: Save is the spoken Data Weapon acquisition operation, clarified by File Save at315.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... So you're here. Come on, show yourself, Data Weapon!
W-what?! That thing is...!!
rows.notes: Deliberate interrupted identification remains unfinished.

rows.en: A s-snake...?!
N-no! I had no idea there was another one!!
So is that thing another Data Weapon?!
Y-yes!
Come, Viper Whip...! Come to me, Altair.
rows.notes: Altair summons Viper Whip to himself; his own name retained in the boast.

rows.en: What's that guy doing?!
Th-this is bad! What Viper Whip seeks in a person's heart is 'confidence'...!
rows.notes: Confidence is Viper Whip's required quality, confirmed by glossary profile.

rows.en: If Knight GEAR Ogre's pilot has more confidence than Hokuto and Ginga...!
rows.notes: Deliberate conditional cliffhanger retained; no gender assigned to the unnamed pilot.

uncertain: Direct English-form source command approved centrally; independent canonical English provenance remains unestablished.

rows.notes: Literal command Viper Drive, install; pending centralized terminology confirmation. Central review approved the direct English-form source command; independent canonical provenance remains unestablished.
uncertain: Direct English-form source command approved centrally; independent canonical English provenance remains unestablished.

rows.en: Th-the Data Weapon is on that thing's arm?!
rows.notes: That thing means Knight GEAR Ogre; no gender inferred.

rows.en: H-how could this happen...!!
Run, Hokuto! Ginga!!
I think I'll take that Gear, too. It only complicates matters when it's in your hands.
Now, you'll feel the Data Weapon's power... on your own bodies!
U-uuugh...!
U-uuugh...!
Hokuto! Ginga!!
How pathetic, Dendoh. Now, I'll test Viper Whip's true power on you!
I won't let you!!
Grrrgh!
Hokuto, Ginga! Get away while you can!!
rows.notes: Restored escape action from Vega's preceding command in320; source leaves action implicit.

rows.en: ! Y-you're...!!
Uuugh! Aaaagh!!
That bastard's started writhing in pain!?
Could it be because he saw me...?
rows.notes: Thought: Altair starts suffering after seeing Vega; supplied he from sourced Altair gender.

rows.en: Ugh... Is this the end for us...!?
Y-you idiot...! If you think you're going to lose, you've already lost...!

rows.notes: Hokuto's nonverbal surprise retained.

rows.notes: Deliberate trailing conditional completed in338/339.

rows.en: Then it really will be hopeless!
rows.notes: Hokuto anticipates Ginga's maxim; identical wording preserved339.

rows.en: Then it really will be hopeless!
rows.notes: Simultaneous echo of338; identical wording.

Everyone's here for us, too! I'm not giving up yet!
All right!!
G-grrgh...! Unicorn Drill is...!
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing observation; completed direction in347.

You can do it! Ginga, Hokuto, use File Save!!

uncertain: Independent canonical English provenance remains unestablished; root approved direct English-form activation command from source.

What!?
If he takes that one, too, we'll really have no chance of winning!
Hold up your Gear Commander and shout "File Save"!
rows.notes: Literal File Save activation call; request is Vega directing boys. Root centrally approved command form; Drive remains distinct from Drill.
uncertain: Independent canonical English provenance remains unestablished; root approved direct English-form activation command from source.

rows.notes: Literal File Save activation call. Root centrally approved command form; Drive remains distinct from Drill.
uncertain: Independent canonical English provenance remains unestablished; root approved direct English-form activation command from source.

Unicorn Drive! Instaaaaall!!
rows.notes: Literal Unicorn Drive activation call; extended install shout preserved. Root centrally approved command form; Drive remains distinct from Drill.
uncertain: Independent canonical English provenance remains unestablished; root approved direct English-form activation command from source.

D-damn you...!!
They actually did it!!
Yes, that was splendid...!
...Unicorn Drill is on Dendoh's arm...!
rows.notes: Restored settled location verb; arm belongs to Dendoh.

Now isn't the time to complain about that!
If only they could use Final Attack now...!

rows.notes: Energy exhausted by preceding fight; deliberately unfinished Cell Fighter wish.

That's the Cell Fighter! Could that be you, Kirakuni!?
Yes! I literally flew here on Chief Shibuya's orders!
How conveniently contrived... I mean, what good timing!
rows.notes: Meta joke: convenient plotting self-corrected to good timing.

rows.en: Kirakuni, the machine isn't fully broken in yet, so please don't push it too hard!
I know, Eris! All right, here I go!!
Ginga, Hokuto! Sorry I'm late!
Kirakuni!?
Kirakuni!?
But now that I'm here, you've got nothing to worry about!
Press switch number 4 on the left grip!
Go, Hokuto, Ginga! Blast him away with Final Attack!
Raaaagh!!
Raaaagh!!
So this is... the power of a Data Weapon...!
rows.notes: Restored copula from settled Data Weapon demonstration.

rows.en: D-damn you, Dendoh!! How dare you do this to me, Altair!!
rows.notes: Altair explicitly speaks own name; preserved name reveal for380/383.

Damn it! I suppose that's enough for today!
That bastard ran away!!
He definitely said Altair...! It couldn't be...!?
rows.notes: Thought: explicit Altair recognition retained without resolving implied identity.

rows.en: Ginga, we have to get that Data Weapon back from him!
rows.notes: Data Weapon stolen by Altair; restored take-back direction.

rows.en: Yeah, I know!
Wait, both of you. Look at the energy gauge.
Ah! It's already dropped this far!
Why? We just changed the batteries, didn't we?
Final Attack packs a punch, but it eats up a tremendous amount of energy.
That's why you have to save it for when it really counts.
S-so that's how it works...
But you don't have to worry.
As long as the Cell Fighter is nearby, we can replace the Hyper Dendoh Batteries, like we just did.
rows.notes: Battery replacement subject we follows Kirakuni support role; canonical plural spelling retained.

rows.en: Of course, we only have a limited supply.
rows.notes: Supply refers to Cell Fighter battery count.

rows.en: That sounds pretty stingy. Can't that thing carry about a hundred at once?
Don't be ridiculous. Even charging one battery is a lot of work.
Huh... Hey, who are you!?
rows.notes: Ginga abruptly recognizes unfamiliar Eris on radio; rude abrupt address retained. Meaning correction: removed added profanity from initial draft; rudeness remains in abrupt address.

A lady!? You're still just a kid!
What are you talking about?! You're a kid too!
rows.notes: Eris retorts to Ginga's child accusation in source399; both children explicit.

rows.en: That's enough chatter! We're taking out the remaining Machine Beasts!
rows.notes: Vega ends the quarrel and directs the team against remaining Machine Beasts.

uncertain: Battle event19 does not name the moving thing; neutral that thing retained rather than identifying a pilot.

rows.notes: Hokuto asks whether that thing is targeting himself and Ginga.

rows.en: It can't be...?!
rows.notes: Vega reacts with disbelief; deliberate incomplete exclamation retained.

rows.notes: Torres reports all Gulfer Machine Beasts driven off to Bright.

...Lanstar... You're saying Taiha was defeated...?

rows.en: Y-yes. I never imagined Zeorymer would unleash that much power...

rows.en: Only its creator, Masaki Kihara, should be capable of doing such a thing.
rows.notes: Its creator is Masaki Kihara, not Masato Akitsu; explicit full name retained.

rows.en: Zeorymer's power source... What lets it surpass the other Hakke robots... And the device that generates its forbidden power...
rows.notes: Luhran lists the same system's three roles; deliberate noun-list fragment retained, no invented new sentence/action.

rows.en: No one but Masaki Kihara could fully master that "Dimensional Coupler System"...
rows.notes: Luhran trails off before asserting that nobody else could master the system; explicit subject/verb retained.

rows.en: But that traitor is dead, isn't he?!
rows.notes: Yuratei identifies the deceased traitor as Kihara from prior two rows; gender sourced in glossary.

rows.en: Y-yes, that is correct...
rows.notes: Luhran's stammered agreement to Yuratei retained.

rows.en: ...Could Kihara have been alive all this time?
rows.notes: Luhran privately wonders whether Kihara survived; no revival claim made.

rows.en: Or did the Committee do something to that man...?
rows.notes: Committee is unnamed; generic action wording retains the unresolved insinuation and trailing question.
uncertain: The Committee is unnamed and its action toward Kihara is left unfinished. Generic do something to retains insinuation; no organization or revival mechanism added.

rows.en: Yuratei, order me to sortie next time!
rows.notes: Giso requests that Yuratei send him next; speaker asks listener, not offering command to listener.

rows.en: No, please send me, Rockfell!
rows.notes: Rockfell competes for the same sortie; self-reference retained by naming Rockfell.

rows.en: I'll be the one to take his head...!
rows.notes: Ritsu volunteers to take the opposing pilot's head; source trails off, threat unsoftened.

rows.notes: Yuratei recalls membership of Hakkeshu before appointment as empress; gender/rank sourced from glossary.

rows.en: And Zeorymer of the Heavens was supposed to be my machine...
rows.notes: Yuratei says Zeorymer of the Heavens should have been her personal machine.
Deliberate silence.

rows.en: Hakkeshu, reclaim Zeorymer at any cost! Without it, the gates of Hades cannot be opened!
rows.notes: Yuratei commands Hakkeshu to recover Zeorymer; Hades matches prior original35 realm language and Hades Project.

rows.en: That "Heaven" is the key to our Tekkoryu's cherished ambition, the "Hades Project"! You must bring it back!
rows.notes: Heaven is quoted shorthand for Zeorymer of the Heavens; ambition and emphatic recovery order retained.

rows.notes: Shi-Aen begins a mission request completed by Shi-Tau in next row; deliberate fragment stays one row.

rows.en: Please entrust it to us!
rows.notes: Shi-Tau finishes request to Yuratei on behalf of both twins; request direction restored with entrust to us.

rows.notes: Yuratei grants request and tells twins to await further orders.

rows.en: Yes, Your Majesty...
rows.notes: Shi-Aen's respectful assent; address inferred from immediate sovereign response.

rows.notes: Saiga's thought refers to Yuratei losing Taiha: original52/72/77/89 and glossary's lover relation settle referents.

rows.en: Last Guardian refused to make contact with us?
rows.notes: Bridge scene resumes: Bright queries Last Guardian's refusal of contact.

rows.notes: Torres conveys Last Guardian's top-secret operation explanation, with stammer and trailing cadence.

rows.en: A top-secret operation...
rows.notes: Bright repeats the secret-operation phrase as a deliberate reaction fragment.

rows.en: It probably concerns that mobile weapon, Captain.
rows.notes: Douglas answers Bright; that mobile weapon refers to Zeorymer.

rows.en: That weapon is called Zeorymer...
rows.notes: Vega supplies the weapon's name to assembled officers.

rows.en: It was brought over fifteen years ago from Hau Dragon, a secret society bent on conquering the world.
rows.notes: Vega explains provenance from world-conquest secret society Hau Dragon fifteen years ago.

rows.en: Deputy Commander, do you know about it?
rows.notes: Ben addresses Vega as deputy commander and asks if she knows the weapon.

rows.en: Yes... It's a robot powered by the Dimensional Coupler System, with truly extraordinary destructive power.
rows.notes: Vega describes the system as power source and extraordinary destructive force; glossary terminology preserved.

rows.en: The Dimensional Coupler System...?
rows.notes: Female lead repeats full system name question; runtime speaker placeholder unchanged.

rows.en: #女愛称... Do you happen to know about it?
rows.notes: Rain addresses the female lead and asks if she knows it; body placeholder unchanged.

rows.en: N-no. But its power output is on a completely different level from a TE Engine or anything like that...
rows.notes: Female lead denies familiarity; full comparison with TE Engine and similar technology retained.

rows.en: Yes... It's amazing that they can control such a tremendous power output.
rows.notes: Rain agrees and marvels at controlling that output; neutral they means the operator(s), no gender guess.

rows.en: Deputy Commander... You said earlier that it was brought over from Hau Dragon, didn't you?
rows.notes: Douglas checks Vega's statement about provenance; full deputy commander address retained.

rows.en: Could that mobile weapon possibly be...
rows.notes: Douglas starts asking whether the mobile weapon belongs to the enemy class; deliberate unfinished question preserved.

rows.en: Yes... It's one of the Hakke robots, the backbone of Hau Dragon's fighting forces.
rows.notes: Vega completes explanation: one Hakke robot, strategic backbone of Hau Dragon.

rows.en: So that thing used to be an enemy robot?
rows.notes: Kaine understands that Zeorymer originated as enemy equipment.

rows.en: Then it's just like the Dragonars.
rows.notes: Judau compares that origin to Dragonars; plural reflects multi-unit group in next row.

rows.en: Yes. Those were new weapons developed by Giganos too.
rows.notes: Ben confirms the Dragonars were new Giganos weapons.

rows.en: ...Captain, there's no point in staying here any longer.
rows.notes: Douglas advises Bright there is no point staying there now.

rows.en: Yes. I'm also concerned about the Data Weapons and that black Dendoh...
rows.notes: Bright also wants information about Data Weapons and black Dendoh; no invented identity reveal.

rows.en: Deputy Commander Vega, could you tell us about them at GEAR?
rows.notes: Bright asks deputy commander Vega to brief them at GEAR; ask direction preserved.

rows.en: Yes...
rows.notes: Vega assents to Bright's briefing request.

rows.en: Well, everyone. It looks like you're all here.
rows.notes: Scene shifts to gathering at GEAR; Dr. Inoue checks everyone is present.

rows.en: Before I explain the Data Weapons, let me introduce our new member.
rows.notes: Inoue introduces a new member before Data Weapon explanation.

rows.en: I'm Eris Willamette. As of today, I've been assigned to the Nahel Argama unit.
rows.notes: Eris supplies full glossary name and says assignment to Nahel Argama unit starts today.

rows.en: I look forward to working with all of you. Please take good care of me.
rows.notes: Eris requests group's goodwill in introduction; speaker asks listeners to take care of her.

rows.en: Ahh! It's that girl from earlier!!
rows.notes: Ginga recognizes Eris from battlefield quarrel; referent restored as that girl.

rows.en: She's the girl who was aboard the Cell Fighter with Kirakuni...
rows.notes: Hokuto identifies Eris as the girl with Kirakuni aboard Cell Fighter; gender explicit in source.

rows.en: A-another young kid has joined us...
rows.notes: Female lead privately reacts to another young recruit; no age number invented.

rows.en: Why's a little brat like you joining our unit?!
rows.notes: Ginga rudely questions a brat's assignment to their unit; insult strength retained.

rows.en: Oh, you're a child yourself, aren't you?
rows.notes: Eris retorts that Ginga himself is also a child.

rows.en: What did you say?!
rows.notes: Ginga's outraged demand for repetition retained.

rows.en: Cut it out, Ginga. You're just repeating what happened earlier.
rows.notes: Hokuto stops Ginga from replaying earlier argument; named listener and explicit subject restored.

rows.en: Oh? Hokuto, when did you start calling Ginga by his name without an honorific?
rows.notes: Michiru notices Hokuto dropped honorific when addressing Ginga; explicit language observation kept despite general dropped-honorific convention.

rows.en: Oh, now that you mention it...
rows.notes: Hokuto realizes the change when Michiru points it out; deliberate reflective ellipsis.

rows.en: Hee hee... You two have become good friends, haven't you?
rows.notes: Michiru laughs warmly about the boys becoming friends; explicit you two referent restored.

rows.en: ...Now then, I'll explain the Data Weapons.
rows.notes: Eris resumes explaining Data Weapons to the group.

rows.en: You'll "explain" them? Why are you doing that?
rows.notes: Ginga challenges Eris's authority to explain; repeating explain preserves skeptical register.

rows.en: Well, you see, Eris graduated from MIT at the age of eleven...
rows.notes: Inoue reveals Eris graduated MIT at eleven; no extra degree or discipline invented.

rows.en: MIT... M-I-T...
rows.notes: Ginga sounds out M-I-T; spelled-out letters distinct from mitt pun in next row.

rows.en: A mitt, huh? Then you used to play baseball, just like me.
rows.notes: Benkei mishears MIT as mitt and wrongly infers Eris played baseball like himself.

rows.en: No, no. That's not it.
rows.notes: Light corrects Benkei's mitt guess; clear subject/verb supplied for denial.

rows.en: Then is it that group with a base at the bottom of Tokyo Bay?
rows.notes: Benkei's second mistaken guess is a group with undersea Tokyo Bay base; no acronym or franchise added.

rows.en: That's MA... Whoops, no, that's not it either.
rows.notes: Female lead begins MA... and self-interrupts, correcting second guess; no completed acronym or expansion.
uncertain: MA... is an inferred English cutoff for source interrupted word; Tokyo Bay underwater base strongly suggests MAT, but acronym is deliberately not completed.

rows.en: Then what is it?
rows.notes: Benkei asks what MIT actually is after both mistaken guesses.

rows.en: MIT stands for the Massachusetts Institute of Technology...
rows.notes: Koji gives full Massachusetts Institute of Technology expansion; source trailing setup retained.

rows.en: It's a famous university with world-class research achievements in science and engineering. I visited it when I was in America too.
rows.notes: Koji states famous university's world-class science/engineering research and his visit while in America.

rows.en: Th-then, could she be...
rows.notes: Ginga starts realizing what graduation implies; deliberate unfinished question retained.

rows.en: Yes. It means she's incredibly gifted.
rows.notes: Light confirms Eris is highly gifted; she sourced by explicit source pronoun and glossary.

rows.en: That's why we recruited her into GEAR... and put her in charge of researching and analyzing the Data Weapons.
rows.notes: Inoue explains GEAR recruited Eris and assigned Data Weapon research/analysis; both actions and tasks retained.

rows.en: She even puts Rain to shame.
rows.notes: Domon jokes that Eris puts Rain to shame; Rain's assent in next source480 confirms comparison.

rows.en: Yes, she really puts me to shame.
rows.notes: Rain responds to Domon saying Eris puts her to shame; explicit subject restored.

rows.en: ...Now I'll explain the Data Weapons. First, please take a look at this.
Oh! What's this, what's this?
A picture came up... That's the horse from before, right?
Yes. These are the six Data Weapons...
rows.notes: Introduces six Data Weapons shown on a chart.

rows.en: On the top row, from left to right: Unicorn Drill, Leo Circle, and Viper Whip...
rows.notes: Chart order preserved: top row, left to right; deliberately trailing continuation.

rows.en: On the bottom row, from left to right: Gatling Boar, Dragon Flare, and Bull Horn.
rows.notes: Chart order preserved: bottom row, left to right.

rows.en: Wow! It's just like a zoo~!
So... what exactly is a Data Weapon?
They're electronic sacred beasts that become Dendoh's weapons.
Electronic sacred beasts...? I think I've heard that somewhere.
rows.notes: Ginga confuses electronic sacred beasts with Ruri's Electronic Fairy nickname.

rows.en: Really? Where? Can you tell me more?
Um, on TV. I think it was a girl just a little older than us...
rows.notes: Female referent established explicitly by source girl; television recollection intentionally trails off.

rows.en: L-listen, that's...
rows.notes: Eris interrupts herself in exasperation.

rows.en: Ginga, that's the 'Electronic Fairy'... Lt. Cmdr. Ruri Hoshino, Nadesico B's beautiful girl captain, the youngest ever.
rows.notes: Full nickname, military rank, full name, beautiful girl description, Nadesico B and youngest-ever distinction preserved; rank follows Ruri glossary Lieutenant Commander. Measured initial4-line overflow; abbreviated Lieutenant Commander to Lt. Cmdr. and tightened youngest captain in history to youngest ever with captain retained earlier; full descriptive meaning retained.

rows.en: Oh, right.
Well, well... You don't look it, Lieutenant, but you're quite the fanboy.
rows.notes: Kaine teases Douglas for celebrity fandom despite his appearance; fanboy preserves the teasing register.

rows.en: Everyone in the military knows that. Everyone!
Is that reaaally true, sir~?
Maybe you've even got some pinup photos hidden away.
rows.notes: Bromide is celebrity photographic merchandise, rendered pinup photos in fandom joke.

rows.en: Y-you lot! Don't make fun of your superior officer!
You're getting awfully worked up. That's suspicious...
You're absolutely right.
Sergeant!
N-nothing, sir! Nothing, Lieutenant!
...Eris, please continue.
Yes. ...Hokuto, could you show me your Gear Commander?
rows.notes: Eris requests Hokuto show her his Gear Commander; request direction preserved.

rows.en: Y-yeah... That Unicorn... Drill thing is still inside, though...
rows.notes: Hokuto hesitates over Unicorn Drill's name, and its being inside.

rows.en: Let me see... Oh my, it really is in there!
When I saw it in battle, it was almost as big as Dendoh...
Yes. I thought it had disappeared, but before I knew it, it was in here...
rows.notes: Unicorn Drill disappeared from full-size battle appearance into Commander; restored referent throughout.

rows.en: Whoa!!
A tiny one just came out of the Gear Commander!
I-it's getting away!
rows.notes: Roux means the small beast is escaping, not that she is fleeing; later537 corrects her interpretation.

rows.en: Hokuto, catch it!!
You say that, but how am I supposed to...?!
rows.notes: Hokuto's inability-to-catch protest is intentionally left unfinished.

rows.en: Daisuke, it's heading your way!
Look out, Daisuke! Get out of the way!
It's all right! Data Weapons in alias form don't have physical bodies!
rows.notes: Alias form follows glossary, with source nonphysical-body explanation fully retained.

rows.en: Then that makes it even harder to catch!
Easy, easy now...!
rows.notes: Spoken horse-calming call, not literal directions.

rows.en: I-it calmed down...?!
That's Daisuke for you. Nobody's better at handling horses!
rows.notes: Horse-handling praise leads into Light's unicorn correction.

rows.en: Wait, that's... a unicorn, isn't it?
Does it really matter which it is right now?
...Hokuto, put Unicorn back in your Gear Commander.
rows.notes: Source short Unicorn form retained; not expanded to Unicorn Drill.

rows.en: Huh? H-how do I do that?
Unicorn came to you because it opened its heart to you.
rows.notes: Unicorn chose Hokuto because it opened its heart; cause retained.

rows.en: A horse won't betray someone it trusts. Try talking to it yourself.
rows.notes: Daisuke asks Hokuto to talk to the beast; request direction retained.

rows.en: I keep telling you, it's a unicorn, isn't it?
rows.notes: Light repeats his earlier horse/unicorn correction.

rows.en: At this point, who cares which it is?
Go on, Hokuto.
Y-yes.
rows.notes: Source stray closing quote and @ indent ignored per brief.

rows.en: C... Come here, Unicorn... Don't be scared. There's nothing to be scared of...
rows.notes: Repetition of reassurance retained.

rows.en: It's taken a liking to Hokuto...
rows.notes: Source beast affection stated with gender-neutral it.

rows.en: It looks like it wasn't trying to run away. It just wanted to play a little.
So in that way, it's like an animal.
But Data Weapons become Dendoh's weapons... and unleash incredible power.
That's the Data Weapons' Final Attack... Each of the six has different power and capabilities.
rows.notes: Final Attack glossary form used without adding unspoken FA expansion.

rows.en: So it's Dendoh's super finishing move.
Yes... If all six Data Weapons were gathered together, they could change the fate of an entire galaxy.
rows.notes: Full entire-galaxy scale and potential modality retained.

rows.en: That's why capturing them is the Gulfer's top priority.
But Data Weapons are Dendoh's weapons, aren't they?
Yeah, exactly. Even if the Gulfer got them, they wouldn't be able to use them, would they?
No, that black Dendoh acquired a Data Weapon... Viper Whip, just as Hokuto acquired his.
rows.notes: Hokuto comparison restored explicitly: he also acquired a Data Weapon.

rows.en: Ginga, Hokuto... The really hard part starts now.
Data Weapons won't unleash their true power just because you've collected them.
To master them, you need a GEAR Fighter's power to command and control them.
rows.notes: Gear Fighter denotes the robot controlling Data Weapons; provisional literal term pending centralized confirmation. Central review approved GEAR Fighter class wording/casing from canonical GEAR Fighter Dendoh prefix; controlling robot class, not a human pilot.

rows.en: And the Gulfer have a GEAR Fighter too... Knight GEAR Ogre.
rows.notes: Gulfer possession of a matching Gear Fighter explained; fixed Knight GEAR Ogre spelling. Central review approved GEAR Fighter class wording/casing from canonical GEAR Fighter Dendoh prefix; controlling robot class, not a human pilot.

rows.en: So a struggle over the Data Weapons will begin between the fighters?
rows.notes: Fighters refers to robots rather than individuals in a generic martial contest. Generic fighters remains lower-case, referring to robot class.

rows.en: Yes...
I could tell from that battle: whoever is piloting Ogre is very skilled.
rows.notes: Pilot gender not inferred from known Altair name; source unnamed whoever retained.

rows.en: Ginga, Hokuto... If you let your guard down fighting that pilot, it'll cost you your lives.
rows.notes: Full lethal warning retained; gender-neutral pilot referent.

rows.en: We'll be fine, Domon. We've got Unicorn Drill's Final Attack now, too.
But... why did Unicorn come to me?
Data Weapons choose their partners of their own free will.
And once a Data Weapon enters its chosen partner's Commander, it won't move to another Commander...
rows.notes: Data Weapon stays in chosen partner's Commander; next row560 supplies exception unless contract dissolved.

rows.en: Unless the contract is broken, of course.
rows.notes: Qualifier continues Eris559; exception is cancellation of contract.

rows.en: So Unicorn won't ever come to my Commander?
That's right.
But a contract... I never did anything like that...
rows.notes: Hokuto deliberately trails off about never making a contract.

rows.en: It isn't something you can see. The contract is formed in your heart.
When a Data Weapon finds what it seeks in a Commander's owner's heart... the condition for its contract...
rows.notes: Conditional continues566; restored Data Weapon subject from contract explanation.

rows.en: It goes to that person and forms a contract.
rows.notes: It refers to Data Weapon in565; contract with Commander holder.

rows.en: That sounds like a pushy salesman.
N-no, um... A pushy salesman...?
rows.notes: Deliberate flustered repetition of Judau pushy-salesman joke.

rows.en: But the contract can be broken, right?
That happens when you lose whatever the Data Weapon seeks from your heart.
Then the contract is broken... and the Data Weapon leaves that person.
So why did Unicorn choose us?
Because Hokuto met the condition Unicorn requires for its contract.
rows.notes: Stray source closing wrapper ignored per brief; Hokuto meets contract condition.

rows.en: What Unicorn seeks... is "trust." The bond between you and Ginga drew it to you, Hokuto.
rows.notes: Unicorn nickname preserved; trust is emotional contract criterion, not Spirit Command.

rows.en: Then why did Viper Whip go to Ogre...?
rows.notes: Restored why/action in context question; Ogre spelling follows name corrections.

rows.en: Viper Whip seeks "confidence." It seems Ogre's pilot had more of that than you two did.
rows.notes: Confidence is emotional selection criterion, not ability label.

rows.en: S-so that means...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished inference answered578.

rows.en: It means you two were immature.
W-well, we've only just started piloting Dendoh...
Anyway, there are four Data Weapons left...
rows.notes: Restored existence/count verb;4 remaining Data Weapons.

rows.en: We absolutely can't let Gulfer get their hands on them.
Can you predict where they'll show up?
rows.notes: They refers to Data Weapons, not Gulfer.

rows.en: Not yet... We haven't determined what makes them appear.
We do know they react to some kind of high energy, but...
rows.notes: Deliberately incomplete caveat.

rows.en: Then why did Unicorn Drill and Viper Whip show up earlier...?
rows.notes: Restored why in question about prior appearance.

rows.en: They may have been drawn to the energy released by Last Guardian's mobile weapons.
But whether that was the deciding factor...
rows.notes: Deliberate uncertainty fragment; not asserted cause.

rows.en: I see... So you joined our unit to find the answer to that, right?
Yes. The Nahel Argama unit's super robots use all sorts of special energy.
I thought the answer might be somewhere among those...
rows.notes: Deliberately trailing explanation of joining unit.

rows.en: Understood. We'll add finding and forming contracts with Data Weapons to our duties.
I'm counting on you, Captain Bright.
rows.notes: Vega asks Bright to take on search/contracts; request direction preserved.

rows.en: That's quite a souvenir you've brought us, Altair.
You captured a Data Weapon before you even arrived here...
rows.notes: Deliberately trailing impressed observation.

rows.en: Hmph... If you fools are still fumbling over something like this, it only proves your incompetence.
Of course, I knew that from the start.
So that's the captain of the Emperor's personal guard...
rows.notes: Thought; captain of Emperor personal guard is Altair.

rows.en: Apparently he's one of only two humans in Gulfer...
rows.notes: Thought; he follows sourced Altair gender; second human not identified.

rows.en: It looks like he outranks Spiral Castle.
rows.notes: Thought; actual rank comparison restored with subject/verb.

rows.en: But for Lord Gades' sake, I won't let you have the remaining Data Weapons...
rows.notes: Thought; Diondra privately refuses Gulfer access for Gades benefit.

rows.en: From now on, I'll take charge of the Data Weapon capture operation.
But that's...
rows.notes: Deliberately interrupted objection.

rows.en: His Majesty entrusted the capture of all of them to me from the very start.
rows.notes: Them refers to Data Weapons; Emperor entrusted all capture to Altair.

rows.en: I trust you understand that, Spiral Castle F-18.
rows.notes: Exact centrally supplied Spiral Castle F-18; independent full-variant provenance unestablished.
uncertain: Spiral Castle F-18 supplied by central glossary; independent canonical full variant remains unestablished.

rows.en: ...I'm tired after the long journey from the Gulfer home planet. I'll rest for a while.
rows.notes: Gulfer home planet exact main glossary; Altair announces own rest.

rows.en: Tch... That mere human is getting far too full of himself.
But he's His Majesty the Emperor's favorite. We can't treat him lightly.
There's no need to worry...
Oyakata-sama...?
rows.notes: Fixed glossary title Oyakata-sama retained; no inferred gender for machine leader.

rows.en: Let's have Altair deal with the humans for a while.
...Their battles so far have shown that they're no fools, either.
rows.notes: They refers to human opponents, not Altair.

rows.en: I see... We'll capture the Data Weapons while Dendoh and Ogre are busy fighting each other.
rows.notes: Dendoh/Ogre fighting creates capture opportunity.

rows.en: That's right... I'll have you work for us once more... Diondra.
rows.notes: Spiral Castle orders Diondra to work again, not offering own services.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... All right.
You fool. We Gyandlar will be the ones to seize that opening.
rows.notes: Thought; Diondra plans Gyandlar to exploit opening instead of Gulfer.

rows.en: ...That woman I saw during the battle...
rows.notes: Thought; deliberate recalled woman fragment; woman is Vega, not named here.

rows.en: Why...? The shock and headache I felt when I saw her...
rows.notes: Thought; deliberate remembered symptoms fragment after question.

rows.en: Is something deep in my memories tormenting me...?
rows.notes: Thought; memory cause remains question, not asserted.

rows.en: ...Awaken from your long slumber, break the seal, and answer my voice.
rows.notes: Ritual register and three imperative actions preserved.

rows.en: ...It has been a long time, Lady Vega.
rows.notes: Unknown speaker remains ???; Lady Vega marks formal superior address.

rows.en: There's something I want to ask.
Yes.
rows.notes: Context follows adjacent battle-event exchange; subject and action restored where required.

rows.en: Could my elder brother Altair have survived that battle in Star Era 4085?
rows.notes: Vega explicitly identifies elder brother Altair; source year4085 exact. Root approved provisional literal Star Era calendar label; no Arctos added where source omits it.
uncertain: Star Era is centrally approved provisional literal calendar label; independent canonical English provenance remains unestablished.

rows.en: With all due respect, Lady Vega... It is as I told you before.
rows.notes: Unknown speaker remains ???; deferential response to Vega question.

rows.en: There is a 99.9% probability that he did not.
rows.notes: Unknown speaker remains ???; probability99.9% attached to non-survival, not survival.

rows.en: ...I see...
